kpis.description_fr: Commercial Risk = courtage assurance entreprises (~55 % du CA Aon). Marché P&C dur depuis 2020, soutien sustainable.
kpis.description_en: Commercial Risk = corporate insurance brokerage (~55% of Aon revenue). Hard P&C market since 2020, sustained tailwind.

kpis.description_fr: Health Solutions = courtage et conseil benefits employer + healthcare consulting. Croissance soutenue.
kpis.description_en: Health Solutions = employer benefits brokerage + healthcare consulting. Sustained growth.

kpis.description_fr: Wealth Solutions = pension / retirement consulting + delegated investment management.
kpis.description_en: Wealth Solutions = pension/retirement consulting + delegated investment management.

kpis.description_fr: Reinsurance = courtage réassurance + capital markets. Marché dur réassurance favorable.
kpis.description_en: Reinsurance = reinsurance brokerage + capital markets. Favorable hard reinsurance market.

kpis.description_fr: Acquisition NFP closée avril 2024 pour 13.4 Mds $. Expansion middle-market USA broking. Plus gros deal de l'histoire Aon.
kpis.description_en: NFP acquisition closed April 2024 for $13.4B. US middle-market broking expansion. Largest deal in Aon history.
